mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ITEM-IS-THE-BUILD unarmed: Facebreaker (Strapped Mitts) grants 600-1000% MORE physical damage with unarmed melee, no weapon equipped (item_alterations, mech_note). PHYSICAL RULE (§1/§4): (1) physical -> element-neutral (element flavor only; identity via geometry+stun); (2) the item DISSOLVES to its mechanic (§4 numeric-modulation uniques -> gear-affix lane) — the 600-1000%-more-unarmed multiplier lands as an unarmed-physical gear-affix/trait scaler, the single largest scaler in the build. melee_strike geometry (§6 single unarmed hit; probe delivery 'at-target' small-radius). stun = physical-punch archetype (probe control lists none; kept minimal). Infernal Blow's corpse-explode-on-kill is a small on-defender-death fire-AoE rider (noted, not the dominant loop). Ancestral Warchief = totem buff-proxy support. T4 ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL (§5 physical rule: the phys-scaling identity; the build IS pure-physical unarmed) + GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade (the Infernal-Blow corpse-explode-chain reading, secondary). CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (pure-physical unarmed scaling) + probe (physical/at-target/mana) per fallback. The 'no weapon slot; gloves are the whole weapon' identity is captured as the unarmed-physical multiplier being the dominant scaler, though the engine abstracts it as a gear-affix rather than a bespoke empty-weapon-slot mechanic.
